description_excerpt: Job Description Key Contributions • Support the creation of 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD tools such as Creo, NX, and Inventor to meet project requirements. • Assist in the design and development of machinery parts and machine assemblies under guidance from senior engineers. • Contribute to design modifications and Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) to improve functionality, quality. • Support project teams by following defined quality processes and maintaining accurate engineering documentation.
